name: Inquiry Engine
description: Implements the active inquiry step in the mesh routing pipeline. Decomposes an accepted signal into dimensions (people, projects, tickets, keywords, sentiment) and queries the worker's context knowledge base for relevant connections. Uses LLM extraction when available, falls back to embedding similarity + keyword overlap. Produces frozen InquiryResult Pydantic models that feed into the assessment phase. Runs ONLY on the single accepting worker (after accept, before consensus). All operations are async and never raise — errors are captured in the result's errors field.

types.name: ExtractionMethod
types.description: Indicates which extraction path was used to produce the inquiry result.

types.name: MatchMethod
types.description: Indicates the method used to find matches for a particular dimension.

types.name: DimensionMatch

fields.name: matched_terms
fields.description: Tuple of matched term strings found in the worker's context for this dimension. Empty tuple if no matches or on failure.

fields.name: scores
fields.description: Tuple of similarity/relevance scores corresponding positionally to matched_terms. Each score in [0.0, 1.0]. Same length as matched_terms.

fields.name: method
fields.description: The method used to find these matches.

types.description: Frozen Pydantic model representing matches found for a single inquiry dimension (e.g., people, projects, tickets, keywords). Uses tuples for true immutability.

types.name: MatchedTerms
types.description: Immutable tuple of matched term strings. Serialized as a list but enforced as tuple at runtime for frozen model compatibility.

types.name: MatchScores
types.description: Immutable tuple of float scores in [0.0, 1.0], positionally corresponding to MatchedTerms.

types.name: SentimentResult

fields.name: polarity
fields.description: Sentiment polarity from -1.0 (very negative) to 1.0 (very positive). 0.0 is neutral.

validators.error_message: Polarity must be between -1.0 and 1.0 inclusive.

fields.name: magnitude
fields.description: Sentiment magnitude/intensity from 0.0 (no sentiment) to 1.0 (very strong). Represents confidence/strength independent of polarity direction.

validators.error_message: Magnitude must be between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Human-readable sentiment label (e.g., 'positive', 'negative', 'neutral', 'mixed'). Derived from polarity and magnitude.

validators.error_message: Sentiment label must be between 1 and 50 characters.

types.description: Frozen Pydantic model representing the sentiment analysis of a signal's content.

functions.name: inquire
functions.description: Primary entry point. Decomposes an accepted signal into dimensions (people, projects, tickets, keywords, sentiment) and queries the worker's context knowledge base for relevant connections. Attempts LLM extraction first if llm_service is provided and available; falls back to embedding similarity + keyword overlap. Parallelizes per-dimension queries via asyncio.gather(). Never raises — all errors are captured in the returned InquiryResult's errors field. Async.

inputs.name: signal
inputs.description: The accepted signal to decompose and inquire upon. Must have a valid non-empty id.

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: The accepting worker's context knowledge base containing terms and embeddings to match against.

inputs.name: llm_service
inputs.description: Optional LLM service for structured dimension extraction. If None or unavailable, falls back to heuristic path.

inputs.name: embedding_service
inputs.description: Optional embedding service for vector similarity in the fallback heuristic path. If None, fallback uses keyword overlap only.

error_cases.name: llm_extraction_failed
error_cases.condition: LLM service was provided and available but extraction call failed (timeout, parse error, service error)

error_data.behavior: Falls back to heuristic path. Error message appended to result.errors. Does not raise.

error_cases.name: embedding_service_failed
error_cases.condition: Embedding service was provided and available but similarity computation failed

error_data.behavior: Falls back to keyword overlap only for affected dimensions. Error message appended to result.errors. Does not raise.

error_cases.name: dimension_query_failed
error_cases.condition: A single dimension query (people, projects, tickets, or keywords) raised an exception

error_data.behavior: That dimension returns empty DimensionMatch (matched_terms=(), scores=(), method='none'). Error appended to result.errors. Other dimensions unaffected. Does not raise.

error_cases.name: sentiment_analysis_failed
error_cases.condition: Sentiment extraction or analysis raised an exception

error_data.behavior: Returns neutral SentimentResult (polarity=0.0, magnitude=0.0, label='neutral'). Error appended to result.errors. Does not raise.

error_cases.name: total_failure
error_cases.condition: All dimension queries and sentiment analysis failed

error_data.behavior: Returns InquiryResult with all empty DimensionMatches, neutral sentiment, extraction_method='heuristic', and all errors in result.errors. Does not raise.
Returns InquiryResult with all empty DimensionMatches and neutral sentiment. Not treated as an error — result.errors remains empty. extraction_method='heuristic'.

preconditions: Signal has been accepted by the worker (scored above threshold) — this function runs only on the accepting worker
Function is called after accept phase and before consensus phase in the mesh routing pipeline
postconditions: Returns a valid InquiryResult — never raises an exception
result.extraction_method is 'llm' if LLM path succeeded, 'heuristic' otherwise
result.timestamp is a valid ISO 8601 UTC timestamp
All scores in each DimensionMatch are in [0.0, 1.0]
If any dimension query failed, the corresponding DimensionMatch has empty matched_terms and the error is recorded in result.errors
If signal.content is empty, all DimensionMatch fields have empty matched_terms and sentiment is neutral (polarity=0.0, magnitude=0.0, label='neutral')
side_effects: May call LLM service (network I/O) if llm_service is provided and available
May call embedding service (network I/O or computation) if embedding_service is provided and available
Reads from context knowledge base (no mutations)

functions.name: extract_dimensions_llm
functions.description: Internal function. Uses the LLM service to extract structured dimensions from signal content. Sends a structured extraction prompt and parses the LLM response into dimension terms and sentiment. Async.

inputs.name: signal_content
inputs.description: The textual content of the signal to extract dimensions from.

inputs.name: llm_service
inputs.description: The LLM service to use for extraction. Must be available.

error_cases.name: llm_timeout
error_cases.condition: LLM service call exceeded timeout threshold

error_cases.name: llm_parse_error
error_cases.condition: LLM response could not be parsed into LLMDimensionExtraction schema

error_cases.name: llm_service_error
error_cases.condition: LLM service returned an error response (rate limit, internal error, etc.)

postconditions: Returns a valid LLMDimensionExtraction with all fields populated

functions.name: match_dimension_embedding
functions.description: Internal function. Matches signal content against context terms for a given dimension using embedding similarity. Computes cosine similarity between the signal content embedding and each context term embedding in the specified dimension. Returns matches above a similarity threshold, sorted by score descending. Async.

inputs.name: signal_content
inputs.description: The textual content to compute an embedding for and compare.

inputs.name: dimension
inputs.description: Which dimension to filter context terms by.

inputs.name: context_terms
inputs.description: The context terms to match against. Only terms matching the specified dimension are considered.

inputs.name: embedding_service
inputs.description: The embedding service to compute signal content embedding.

inputs.name: similarity_threshold
inputs.description: Minimum cosine similarity score to include a match. Default 0.5.

validators.error_message: Similarity threshold must be between 0.0 and 1.0.

error_cases.name: embedding_computation_failed
error_cases.condition: Embedding service failed to compute embedding for signal content

error_cases.name: no_terms_in_dimension
error_cases.condition: No context terms exist for the specified dimension

error_data.behavior: Returns empty DimensionMatch with method='embedding_similarity'. Not an error.

preconditions: All context terms in the specified dimension have non-empty embeddings
All embeddings have the same dimensionality
postconditions: All scores in result.scores are >= similarity_threshold
result.matched_terms and result.scores have equal length
Results are sorted by score descending
side_effects: Calls embedding service to compute signal content embedding (may involve network I/O)

functions.name: match_dimension_keyword
functions.description: Internal function. Matches signal content against context terms for a given dimension using keyword/lexical overlap. Computes normalized overlap score between tokenized signal content and each context term. Returns matches above a score threshold, sorted by score descending. Pure computation — no external service calls. Async (for uniform interface with other matchers).

inputs.name: signal_content
inputs.description: The textual content to tokenize and match.

inputs.name: dimension
inputs.description: Which dimension to filter context terms by.

inputs.name: context_terms
inputs.description: The context terms to match against. Only terms matching the specified dimension are considered.

inputs.name: score_threshold
inputs.description: Minimum keyword overlap score to include a match. Default 0.3.

validators.error_message: Score threshold must be between 0.0 and 1.0.

error_cases.name: no_terms_in_dimension
error_cases.condition: No context terms exist for the specified dimension

error_data.behavior: Returns empty DimensionMatch with method='keyword_overlap'. Not an error.

postconditions: All scores in result.scores are >= score_threshold
result.matched_terms and result.scores have equal length
Results are sorted by score descending

functions.name: analyze_sentiment
functions.description: Internal function. Analyzes the sentiment of signal content. Uses LLM extraction result if available, otherwise applies a heuristic sentiment analysis. Async.

inputs.name: signal_content
inputs.description: The textual content to analyze sentiment for.

inputs.name: llm_extraction
inputs.description: If LLM extraction was performed, the result containing LLM-derived sentiment. None if LLM path was not used.

error_cases.name: heuristic_analysis_failed
error_cases.condition: Heuristic sentiment analysis encountered an unexpected error

error_data.behavior: Caller catches and returns neutral sentiment.

postconditions: If signal_content is empty, returns neutral sentiment (polarity=0.0, magnitude=0.0, label='neutral')
If llm_extraction is provided, uses LLM-derived sentiment values

functions.name: merge_dimension_matches
functions.description: Internal function. Merges DimensionMatch results from embedding similarity and keyword overlap paths into a single combined DimensionMatch. Deduplicates by term (keeping highest score), re-sorts by score descending. Uses signal ID set intersection for merge detection as per engineering decision — not embedding similarity.

inputs.name: embedding_match
inputs.description: DimensionMatch from embedding similarity path.

inputs.name: keyword_match
inputs.description: DimensionMatch from keyword overlap path.

postconditions: For terms present in both inputs, the higher score is kept
result.matched_terms and result.scores have equal length
Results are sorted by score descending

functions.name: make_empty_dimension_match
functions.description: Factory function. Creates an empty DimensionMatch with no matches, used as a safe default when a dimension query fails or when signal content is empty.

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: The method to record in the empty result, indicating what was attempted.

functions.name: make_neutral_sentiment
functions.description: Factory function. Creates a neutral SentimentResult, used as a safe default when sentiment analysis fails or when signal content is empty.

invariants: InquiryResult is a frozen (immutable) Pydantic model — no fields may be mutated after construction
DimensionMatch is a frozen (immutable) Pydantic model — no fields may be mutated after construction
SentimentResult is a frozen (immutable) Pydantic model — no fields may be mutated after construction
All collection fields use tuple (not list) for true immutability at runtime
inquire() never raises an exception — all errors are captured in InquiryResult.errors
For every DimensionMatch: all values in scores are in [0.0, 1.0]
For every SentimentResult: polarity is in [-1.0, 1.0] and magnitude is in [0.0, 1.0]
Active inquiry runs ONLY on the single accepting worker — never broadcast to multiple workers
Inquiry executes after the accept phase and before the consensus phase in the mesh routing pipeline
All timestamps are ISO 8601 with UTC timezone (Z suffix)
All embedding vectors have the same dimensionality within a given context
Merge detection uses signal ID set intersection, not embedding similarity
The LLM path is attempted first; heuristic path is used only as fallback
Per-dimension queries are parallelized via asyncio.gather() for performance
